report.answer_text:
Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi shared the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine “for their discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance.” (nobelprize.org)
Sakaguchi discovered regulatory T cells, which help prevent the immune system from attacking the body’s own tissues. Brunkow and Ramsdell identified the FOXP3 gene and linked mutations in it to severe autoimmune disease. Sakaguchi then showed that the gene is essential for the development of regulatory T cells. (nobelprize.org)
